svg.title: Wireframe 07: Settings
svg.desc: Settings screen with sections: run targets (local only in Phase 1), runs and limits (runs at once, time limit in seconds, memory limit in bytes, each with its plain value), hardware (detected from GET /v1/system, the tier override), engines (GET /v1/engines), the five findings thresholds with the service's W220 issues, appearance (theme, text size, motion, colour-blind safe charts), canvas (ask before deleting, undo steps), Restore all defaults for those preferences after a question, service (remote access not available; the idle timeout in minutes, added at M11 for AKS-141) and about. Each section says when its settings take effect: the run settings, the tier and the idle timeout at the next start of the service, the thresholds at the next results, the preferences at once.
